lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 27 — Paul Sails for Rome / The Storm and Shipwreck

questions.questionText: I am the centurion of the Imperial Regiment who took charge of Paul. Who am I?
I am a Macedonian from Thessalonica traveling with Paul. Who am I?
Julius let Paul visit friends in which city?
The centurion found an Alexandrian ship at which port?
They reached Fair Havens near which town?
Who warned that the voyage would be disastrous?
Whose advice did the centurion follow instead of Paul’s?
options: The pilot and the owner of the ship

questions.questionText: They hoped to winter at which harbor in Crete?
What was the hurricane-force wind called?
They passed the lee of a small island called what?
They feared running aground on the sandbars of where?
The next day they threw what overboard?
On the third day they threw what overboard?
True or false: Neither sun nor stars appeared for many days and they gave up hope.
Who stood beside Paul at night?
You must stand trial before Caesar. Who said this?
True or false: God gave Paul the lives of all who sailed with him.
Paul said not one of you will be lost; only the _____ will be destroyed.
On the fourteenth night they were driven across which sea?
Soundings were twenty fathoms then how many?
How many anchors did they drop from the stern?
Who tried to escape in the lifeboat?
Unless these men stay with the ship, you cannot be saved. Who said this?
What did soldiers do to the lifeboat ropes?
options: Cut them and let the boat drift away

questions.questionText: How many days had they gone without food when Paul urged them to eat?
Who gave thanks, broke bread and ate?
How many people were on board?
They threw what into the sea to lighten the ship?
The ship struck a sandbar. What happened to the stern?
options: It was broken to pieces by the surf

questions.questionText: Who planned to kill the prisoners?
Who stopped that plan to spare Paul’s life?
Those who could not swim used what to get to land?
options: Planks or pieces of the ship

questions.questionText: True or false: Everyone reached land in safety.
options: True — the ship was saved too

questions.questionText: Fair Havens was on which island?
True or false: Sailing was dangerous because the Fast was already over.
options: True — Paul wanted to sail more

questions.questionText: I belong to the Imperial Regiment. Who am I?
They landed at Myra in which region?
True or false: Paul said he had faith in God that it would happen as he was told.
A gentle south wind made them think they had what they wanted, so they sailed along Crete. Then what hit?
True or false: They passed ropes under the ship to hold it together.
When it was decided that we would sail for Italy, Paul and some other prisoners were handed over to a centurion named Julius. What regiment did he belong to?
Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was traveling with them. From which city was he?
The next day they put in at Sidon. What did Julius allow Paul to do?
options: Go to his friends so they might provide for his needs

questions.questionText: They put out to sea and sailed to the lee of Cyprus because the winds were against them. Later they landed at Myra in Lycia. What kind of ship did the centurion find there?
options: An Alexandrian ship sailing for Italy

questions.questionText: Paul said, “Men, I can see that our voyage is going to be disastrous.” Who ignored Paul’s warning?
options: The centurion, the pilot and the owner of the ship

questions.questionText: They dropped four anchors from the stern and prayed for daylight. Who tried to sneak away in the lifeboat?
Paul told them that not one of them would lose a single hair from his head. Then he took bread, gave thanks, and they were all encouraged and ate. How many were on board?
